title: Carbon footprint of alternative protein sources for Atlantic salmon (Salmo salar) aquaculture: A two-step systematic literature review
study_objective: To quantify the carbon footprint of alternative protein sources relevant to Atlantic salmon aquaculture through a two-step systematic literature review.
focal_factor_detail: alternative protein sources for salmon feed

title: Design, dimensioning, and performance of a research facility for studies on the requirements of fish in RAS environments
study_system_detail: NCRA; four independent recirculating aquaculture systems
study_objective: To describe the design and dimensioning of a research facility for studying fish requirements in RAS environments and evaluate its performance during the first years of operation.
focal_factor_detail: RAS facility design/performance and feed loading
comparison_detail: increasing feed loads; observed performance versus design assumptions; growth versus Norwegian industry
study_outcome_detail: TAN, nitrite and CO2 concentrations/removal efficiency; feed-load capacity; Atlantic salmon growth rate
